title: Phase 2 Study of Lovastatin as Breast Cancer Chemoprevention

sections.abstract:
The study evaluates if a 6-month course of oral lovastatin at 80 mg/day would decrease abnormal breast duct cytology in women with a high inherited breast cancer risk.

Posted outcomes: Change in the Incidence of Abnormal Breast Duct Cytology After Treatment With Lovastatin 80 mg/Day. timeframe=6 months. Baseline Non-proliferative Breast Disease (NPBD)=8; Baseline Proliferative Breast Disease Without Atypia (PBD-A)=5; Baseline Biopsy Acellular=1
